description: Moves the pins in versions.conf and packages.json (#3284). Dependabot keeps gomod, github-actions and docker, so only the custom managers run here.

customManagers.description: versions.conf: each pin has a `# renovate:` line above it, and above its `# mise:` or `# pwsh-module:` marker when it has one. `# renovate: skip <reason>` does not match, so the pin stays out.
CI builds dotf with the go line of cli/go.mod, so it moves in the same PR as GO_VERSION.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch bumps answer the knowledge gate themselves: Renovate's PRs are authored by the token's owner, so the gate's bot skip never applies. A major gets no section, so the gate stays red until someone writes what changed.
prBodyNotes:
## Knowledge

- Lesson: none: a minor or patch pin bump records no new behaviour
- ADR: none: no decision is made by moving a pin
- Runbook: none: docs/runbooks/tool-installation.md already says how pins move

packageRules.description: One minor-and-patch PR per depType instead of the preset's single group. Renovate's PRs are authored by the token's owner, so the spec-gate's bot skip never applies; each group stays under its 50-line threshold, and renovate_test.go fails when one would not.
Go moves by patch only: a minor release has broken the pinned golangci-lint (it panicked under Go 1.27), so a minor is a decision, not a bump.
Release binaries run in CI with the repository's secrets, so they wait the same three days the preset gives npm, pypi and go.
